## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A same-and-not-transient failure stops retrying before the ceiling, asserted...

The system SHALL ensure that a same-and-not-transient failure stops retrying before the ceiling, asserted by a test that counts attempts against the current count-only baseline.

#### Scenario: A same-and-not-transient failure stops retrying before the ceiling, asserted...

WHEN `classify-retries-by-sameness-and-transience` is implemented
THEN A same-and-not-transient failure stops retrying before the ceiling, asserted by a test that counts attempts against the current count-only baseline.

### Requirement: The retry ceiling is unchanged and still terminates, covered by a test where...

The system SHALL ensure that the retry ceiling is unchanged and still terminates, covered by a test where both Nouls are inconclusive.

#### Scenario: The retry ceiling is unchanged and still terminates, covered by a test where...

WHEN `classify-retries-by-sameness-and-transience` is implemented
THEN The retry ceiling is unchanged and still terminates, covered by a test where both Nouls are inconclusive.

### Requirement: The emitted failure_type uses the existing enum values consumed by...

The system SHALL ensure that the emitted failure_type uses the existing enum values consumed by improve-harness, validated against that consumer's schema.

#### Scenario: The emitted failure_type uses the existing enum values consumed by...

WHEN `classify-retries-by-sameness-and-transience` is implemented
THEN The emitted failure_type uses the existing enum values consumed by improve-harness, validated against that consumer's schema.

### Requirement: With the helper returning None the consecutive-failure count governs and...

The system SHALL ensure that with the helper returning None the consecutive-failure count governs and existing phase_fixer retry tests pass unchanged.

#### Scenario: With the helper returning None the consecutive-failure count governs and...

WHEN `classify-retries-by-sameness-and-transience` is implemented
THEN With the helper returning None the consecutive-failure count governs and existing phase_fixer retry tests pass unchanged.
